Subject: Re: [opensuse] openSUSE and faxes

Per Jessen wrote:
> David C. Rankin wrote:
>> Per,
>>
>>     How did you set it up as a printer? kprinter->add-psuedo-printer?
>> Then what in the command line?
>>
> 
> Hi David,
> 
> I used the spadmin utility from openoffice to set up a printer "Faxprint".
> 
> It uses sendfax:
> 
> /usr/bin/sendfax -S A4 -D -n -f  -
> 
> 
> Whenever I send a fax from office, I get a little dialogue box prompting
> me for the fax-number, and that's it.  I think I would have preferred a
> solution via cups, but this worked right away, so I didn't do more about
> it.  If I had more PCs that needed fax-capability, I would try to do it
> with cups.
> 
> 
> /Per
> 

Thanks Per,

	I'll give it a shot in the morning!
